description.en: Intended to check whether the whole team's GP gauges are maxed out (loops the roster comparing each member's GP against a stored value). Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/. As with CMND_GP_IS_MAX, the loop's comparison result doesn't appear to feed into the traced return value — treat the exact check semantics with caution.
True on any valid call (the internal per-member comparison doesn't visibly affect the returned value in the decompiled code); null if the call was invalid or the roster data isn't ready.

example.code:
// Check whether the whole team's GP gauges are maxed out
local teamGpMaxed = CMND_TEAM_GP_IS_MAX();
